Contact AICORE - Start a Project

Tell AICORE about your AI, automation, IoT, or software project. We respond within 24 hours.

Contact AICORE Technologies at support@aicoret.com. Phone: +234 701 072 9722. Offices: Lagos: 117 Alhaji Amoo Street, Lagos, Nigeria; Osogbo: 6, Timothy House, Beside Moshodun Complex, Alekuwodo, Osogbo, Osun State.

How quickly does AICORE respond to enquiries? AICORE typically responds within 1 business day after receiving a project, product demo, academy, partnership, or general enquiry.

What information should I include in my enquiry? Describe the workflow, system, device, data, or business problem you want to improve. Include current tools, users, timeline, and any technical requirements or limits if you know them.

Can we talk through the idea before committing to a project? Yes. AICORE can review your idea or operational challenge, suggest a practical next step, and outline the likely scope before a formal project begins.

Does AICORE support clients outside Lagos? Yes. AICORE works with clients across Nigeria and beyond, with offices in Lagos and Osogbo and remote collaboration for software, AI, automation, and IoT projects.
